actions.namedLobbyist: Maritza Haro Salgado, Esq., 200 South Biscayne Boulevard, Suite 300, Miami

note.en: A split vote: Council President Zogby and Council Member Marrero voted no. Gonzalez was absent for the August 25 first reading (6-0). The agenda lists the lobbyist at 200 South Biscayne Blvd, Suite 300, the office of Bercow Radell Fernandez Larkin & Tapanes, which gave $1,000; 1025 Hialeah Development LLC and 1067 Hialeah Development LLC (same address, 4259 SW 72 Ave) gave $1,000 each. All three gifts came five weeks after the vote.
note.es: Votación dividida: el presidente del Concejo Zogby y el concejal Marrero votaron en contra. Gonzalez estuvo ausente en la primera lectura del 25 de agosto (6-0). La agenda ubica a la cabildera en 200 South Biscayne Blvd, Suite 300, la oficina de Bercow Radell Fernandez Larkin & Tapanes, que donó $1,000; 1025 Hialeah Development LLC y 1067 Hialeah Development LLC (misma dirección, 4259 SW 72 Ave) dieron $1,000 cada una. Las tres donaciones llegaron cinco semanas después del voto.
note.ht: Yon vòt divize: Prezidan Konsèy Zogby ak Konseye Marrero te vote non. Gonzalez te absan pou premye lekti 25 out la (6-0). Ajennda a mete lobiyis la nan 200 South Biscayne Blvd, Suite 300, biwo Bercow Radell Fernandez Larkin & Tapanes, ki te bay $1,000; 1025 Hialeah Development LLC ak 1067 Hialeah Development LLC (menm adrès, 4259 SW 72 Ave) chak te bay $1,000. Tout twa kado yo te rive senk semèn apre vòt la.

note.en: Split votes: Vice President De La Vega and Council Member Monica Perez voted no on all three ordinances; a companion alley closure passed 5-0-2. Hugo Arza gave $1,000 on October 13, 2026; the report lists him as an owner at a Miami home address, so the match is by name only.
note.es: Votaciones divididas: la vicepresidenta De La Vega y la concejal Monica Perez votaron en contra de las tres ordenanzas; el cierre de callejón asociado pasó 5-0-2. Hugo Arza donó $1,000 el 13 de octubre de 2026; el reporte lo lista como propietario con una dirección residencial en Miami, así que la coincidencia es solo por nombre.
note.ht: Vòt divize: Vis Prezidan De La Vega ak Konseye Monica Perez te vote non sou tout twa òdonans yo; fèmti ale ki mache ak li a te pase 5-0-2. Hugo Arza te bay $1,000 nan 13 oktòb 2026; rapò a mete l kòm pwopriyetè ak yon adrès kay Miami, kidonk koresponn lan se sou non sèlman.

note.en: Two resolutions the same night awarded three-year continuing contracts in ranked order; work is assigned later as needs arise. Ignacio Serracta, who gave $500, lists his occupation as SRS engineer.

note.ht: De rezolisyon menm swa a te bay kontra kontinyèl twa zan nan lòd klasman; travay la bay pita selon bezwen. Ignacio Serracta, ki te bay $500, deklare li se enjenyè SRS.
